title: View all cases
View calculated metrics
View working calendar
Data quality and calendar coverage; violation counts must be zero.
Employee evidence for year-end review; CSAT denominator is survey responses.
sql:
SELECT employee_id,COUNT(*) AS total_cases,
 ROUND(AVG(response_work_minutes),2) AS avg_response_work_minutes,
 SUM(response_target_met) AS prompt_responses,ROUND(100.0*AVG(response_target_met),1) AS prompt_response_pct,
 SUM(within_sla) AS within_sla_cases,ROUND(100.0*AVG(within_sla),1) AS within_sla_pct,
 SUM(same_day_refund) AS same_day_refunds,SUM(rework_required) AS rework_cases,
 COUNT(csat_score) AS survey_responses,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(csat_score)/COUNT(*),1) AS survey_coverage_pct,
 ROUND(AVG(csat_score),2) AS avg_csat,
 SUM(low_rating) AS low_ratings,
 SUM(CASE WHEN low_rating=1 AND feedback_responsibility='Employee' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS service_related_low_ratings
FROM service_metrics GROUP BY employee_id;

title: Monthly review: count and rate stay separate; do not average monthly rates.
sql:
SELECT received_month,COUNT(*) AS cases,ROUND(AVG(response_work_minutes),2) AS avg_response_min,
 ROUND(100.0*AVG(response_target_met),1) AS prompt_pct,SUM(within_sla) AS within_sla,
 SUM(rework_required) AS rework_cases,COUNT(csat_score) AS survey_responses,
 ROUND(AVG(csat_score),2) AS avg_csat,SUM(low_rating) AS low_ratings
FROM service_metrics GROUP BY received_month ORDER BY received_month;

title: Feedback context; category is an illustrative reviewed attribution, not inferred from rating.
sql:
SELECT feedback_responsibility,COUNT(*) AS low_ratings
FROM service_metrics WHERE low_rating=1 GROUP BY feedback_responsibility;

title: Evidence requiring review before a reward decision.
sql:
SELECT case_id,received_at,response_work_minutes,rework_required,csat_score,
 feedback_theme,feedback_responsibility,feedback_note
FROM service_metrics
WHERE response_target_met=0 OR rework_required=1 OR low_rating=1
ORDER BY received_at;

title: Separate employee verification from accounting-posting wait.
sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(verification_workdays),2) AS avg_verification_workdays,
 ROUND(AVG(accounting_wait_work_minutes),2) AS avg_accounting_wait_work_minutes,
 ROUND(AVG(customer_wait_hours),2) AS avg_customer_wait_clock_hours
FROM service_metrics;
